chapters.t: Jesus was born in the town of Bethlehem. An angel told Mary she would have a baby.
Mary's baby was Jesus, God's son. He came to save all people.
Some wise men from far away came to see baby Jesus. They brought him gifts of gold, incense, and myrrh.
Jesus grew up in a town called Nazareth. He was a good boy.
When Jesus grew up, John baptized him in the river Jordan.
God's spirit came down like a dove on Jesus. God said, 'This is my son. I love him.'
Jesus went into the desert. He was alone for 40 days.
Satan tried to trick Jesus, but Jesus did not listen to Satan.
Jesus began to teach people. Many people came to listen to him.
Jesus said, 'Blessed are those who are sad. God will make them happy.'
Jesus said, 'Love your enemies. Do good to those who are mean to you.'
Jesus taught that we should love God with all our heart.
He said we should love our neighbors as much as we love ourselves.
Jesus healed a man who could not walk. He said, 'Get up! Your sins are forgiven. Walk!'
The man got up and walked! Everyone was amazed.
Jesus healed a sick woman just by touching her clothes.
Jesus made a blind man see again.
Jesus called twelve men to be his helpers. They were called apostles or disciples.
He said to them, 'Come and follow me. I will teach you to be fishers of men.'
Jesus told a story about a man who planted seeds.
Some seeds fell on the hard road and birds ate them.
Some seeds fell on rocks and died because they had no water.
But some seeds fell on good soil. They grew into big, strong plants with lots of grain.
Jesus said, 'My word is like the good seeds. Listen to God's word and it will grow in your heart.'
Jesus and his helpers got into a boat. They went out on the water.
A big storm came. The wind was very strong. The waves were very big.
Jesus's helpers were scared. They said, 'Jesus, help us! We are going to die!'
Jesus said, 'Why are you afraid? Don't you believe in me?'
Then Jesus told the storm to stop. The wind stopped. The water was calm.
A man asked Jesus to heal his sick daughter. Jesus went to see her.
Jesus took her hand and said, 'Little girl, get up!'
The girl got up! She was not sick anymore.
Jesus saw a boy who had only five little loaves of bread and two small fish.
Jesus took the bread and fish. He said thank you to God.
Jesus broke the bread and fish into pieces.
He gave the food to his helpers. They gave it to the people.
Everyone ate until they were full! More than 5,000 people ate that day.
Jesus walked on the water! His helpers were in a boat.
They saw Jesus walking toward them. They were very afraid!
Jesus said, 'Don't be afraid! It is me, Jesus.'
Peter said, 'Jesus, if that is you, tell me to walk to you on the water!'
Jesus said, 'Come on!' Peter got out of the boat and walked on the water to Jesus!
Jesus said, 'Let the little children come to me. Don't tell them to go away.'
Jesus hugged the children and blessed them.
Jesus said, 'God's kingdom belongs to those who are like little children. They are pure and simple and believe.
Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a donkey.
People waved palm branches and said, 'Hosanna! Blessed is Jesus!'
Jesus went to the temple and chased out the people who were being mean.
Jesus said, 'My house should be a place of prayer for all people.'
Jesus had a special dinner with his friends. This is called the Last Supper.
Jesus took bread and broke it. He said, 'This is my body. Eat this to remember me.'
Jesus took a cup of wine and said, 'This is my blood. Drink this to remember me.'
Jesus knew that bad people would catch him soon.
Soldiers caught Jesus. They were very mean to him. They made fun of him.
They put a crown of thorns on his head. They hit him.
They put Jesus on a cross. Jesus died on the cross for our sins.
Jesus's friends put him in a tomb. They closed it with a big stone.
But three days later, Jesus came back to life! He rose from the dead!
An angel told the women, 'Jesus is alive! He is not here anymore!'
Jesus appeared to his friends. He said, 'Don't be afraid. I am alive! I will always be with you.'
Jesus said, 'Go and teach all people about me. Baptize them in the name of God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.'
